name: Unifi-controller
tagline: The Unifi-controller software is a powerful, enterprise wireless software engine ideal for high-density client deployments requiring low latency and high uptime performance.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/unifi-controller:8.0.24@sha256:0ae315a3a45635e443899e30e86bd507c2c48922cb27f4bc7241777885f4650e
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      MEM_LIMIT: ''
      MEM_STARTUP: ''
    ports:
      - target: 8443
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3478
        published: 3478
        protocol: udp
      - target: 10001
        published: 10001
        protocol: udp
      - target: 8080
        published: 8080
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 1900
        published: 1900
        protocol: udp
      - target: 8843
        published: 8843
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 8880
        published: 8880
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 6789
        published: 6789
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 5514
        published: 5514
        protocol: udp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
